entries.title: Genesis 10:1
segments: ¶Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth: these are the sons which they had after the great flow of waters

entries.title: Genesis 10:2
segments: The sons of Japheth: Gomer and Magog and Madai and Javan and Tubal and Meshech and Tiras.

entries.title: Genesis 10:3
segments: And the sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz and Riphath and Togarmah.

entries.title: Genesis 10:4
segments: And the sons of Javan: Elishah and Tarshish, the Kittim and the Dodanim.

entries.title: Genesis 10:5
segments: From these came the nations of the sea-lands, with their different families and languages.

entries.title: Genesis 10:6
segments: ¶And the sons of Ham: Cush and Mizraim and Put and Canaan.

entries.title: Genesis 10:7
segments: And the sons of Cush: Seba and Havilah and Sabtah and Raamah and Sabteca; and the sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.

entries.title: Genesis 10:8
segments: And Cush was the father of Nimrod, who was the first of the great men of the earth.

entries.title: Genesis 10:9
segments: He was a very great bowman, so that there is a saying, Like Nimrod, a very great bowman.

entries.title: Genesis 10:10
segments: And at the first, his kingdom was Babel and Erech and Accad and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

entries.title: Genesis 10:11
segments: From that land he went out into Assyria, building Nineveh with its wide streets and Calah,

entries.title: Genesis 10:12
segments: And Resen between Nineveh and Calah, which is a very great town.

entries.title: Genesis 10:13
segments: And Mizraim was the father of the Ludim and Anamim and Lehabim and Naphtuhim;

entries.title: Genesis 10:14
segments: And Pathrusim and Casluhim and Caphtorim, from whom came the Philistines.

entries.title: Genesis 10:15
segments: ¶And Canaan was the father of Zidon, who was his oldest son, and Heth,

entries.title: Genesis 10:16
segments: And the Jebusite and the Amorite and the Girgashite,

entries.title: Genesis 10:17
segments: And the Hivite and the Arkite and the Sinite,

entries.title: Genesis 10:18
segments: And the Arvadite and the Zemarite and the Hamathite; after that the families of the Canaanites went far and wide in all directions;

entries.title: Genesis 10:19
segments: Their country stretching from Zidon to Gaza, in the direction of Gerar; and to Lasha, in the direction of Sodom and Gomorrah and Admah and Zeboiim.

entries.title: Genesis 10:20
segments: All these, with their different families, languages, lands, and nations, are the offspring of Ham.

entries.title: Genesis 10:21
segments: ¶And Shem, the older brother of Japheth, the father of the children of Eber, had other sons in addition.

entries.title: Genesis 10:22
segments: These are the sons of Shem: Elam and Asshur and Arpachshad and Lud and Aram.

entries.title: Genesis 10:23
segments: And the sons of Aram: Uz and Hul and Gether and Mash.

entries.title: Genesis 10:24
segments: And Arpachshad became the father of Shelah; and Shelah became the father of Eber.

entries.title: Genesis 10:25
segments: And Eber had two sons: the name of the one was Peleg, because in his time the peoples of the earth became separate; and his brother's name was Joktan.

entries.title: Genesis 10:26
segments: And Joktan was the father of Almodad and Sheleph and Hazarmaveth and Jerah

entries.title: Genesis 10:27
segments: And Hadoram and Uzal and Diklah

entries.title: Genesis 10:28
segments: And Obal and Abimael and Sheba

entries.title: Genesis 10:29
segments: And Ophir and Havilah and Jobab; all these were the sons of Joktan.

entries.title: Genesis 10:30
segments: And their country was from Mesha, in the direction of Sephar, the mountain of the east.

entries.title: Genesis 10:31
segments: These, with their families and their languages and their lands and their nations, are the offspring of Shem.

entries.title: Genesis 10:32
segments: These are the families of the sons of Noah, in the order of their generations and their nations: from these came all the nations of the earth after the great flow of waters.
